### L1 review (#35092) · 2026-11-18T06:03Z

L1: REWORK (one must-fix, in the new e2e spec only)
Head-sha: fbeab193b860badfb19f69bd9c68b28ef0fa7764

This is the first L1 on this PR. I read the full diff against the merge-base `0e46840fca`: 5 files, +664/−61. I also read the card (its 不做的 list is the scope fence), the claim 6969497172 and the os-dev report 6970347351.

**The fix, read against the card's 要做的.**
- Item 1: the jump now calls `scrollToHeading(heading)`. It finds the scroller with the file's existing `scrollParentOf` and calls `scroller.scrollTo({ top: scrollTop + headingTop − viewTop − scroll-margin-top − scroll-padding-top, behavior: 'smooth' })`. When there is no scroller it calls `window.scrollTo` with the root's `scroll-padding-top`. The element `scrollIntoView` is gone from the jump. A collapsed section still unfolds first and is revealed one frame later, as before.
- Item 2 (the defence): `ModalForm`'s form scroller gains `relative`. The only other absolute element in `ModalForm` is the close button (line 1262), which sits outside the scroller. Popovers are portaled, so the containing-block change reaches only the hidden native inputs the card names. The report's reading agrees.
- The fence holds. The `atBottom` / `jumpedTo` highlight rule, folding and required counts are unchanged in the source. In the test file, the #34819 highlight describe's fixture moved to module scope so that the new describe can share it. Its three `aria-current` assertions are unchanged, and the file goes from 11 to 14 tests.

**Shape and scope.**
- `Fixes #35092` is on the first card line, with no closing keyword next to another open card. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` match the diff: no export changes and no spec change.
- All 5 paths are inside the claim: `FormSectionNav.tsx`, `ModalForm.tsx`, their test, one `ui/e2e` spec and the root changeset. No `content/docs/releases/` change. Not governed, below the 3,000-line threshold. No L2 is owed.

**Changeset.** `.changeset/35092-section-nav-dialog-scroll.md` is new and edits no changeset on main, so there is no freeze flag. It covers `@object-ui/plugin-form` as `patch`, the only package touched. I checked its sentences against the diff:
- "an element `scrollIntoView`, which also scrolls every scrollable ancestor … It now scrolls only the heading's own scroller (the form's body, or the window for a full-page form) with `scrollTo`, keeping the heading's scroll margin." This matches `scrollToHeading`.
- "The dialog's form body is now `relative`, so the hidden native inputs … are clipped by the form body and scroll with it." This matches `ModalForm.tsx:1410`.
- "The highlight rule, section folding and the required-field counts are unchanged." This matches the source diff.
- "the user had to close the dialog and lose what they had typed" goes a step beyond the card's 只能关掉重开, but closing a create dialog does drop its values, so I accept it.

**Tests and evidence.**
- Unit pins (`FormSectionNav.test.tsx`): the jump asks the scroller with the computed `top`, never calls `scrollIntoView`, keeps the scroll margin, falls back to the window, and asks only the scroller for a short last section. The unit ablation (jump replaced by `scrollIntoView`) turned 6 of 14 red and was restored to blob == HEAD.
- The e2e spec builds the real `FormSectionNav` from source with real Tailwind for the class strings read from the sources. Its fixtures are declared in its header. The matrix holds the defect, each half alone, every entry at a desktop and a zoomed viewport, and the short last section. That covers all three of the card's 验收 lines.

**CI at this head**, read from check-runs (57): 42 success, 15 skipped, none failed. But see M1: `Build & E2E UI` is green only because of a retry.

#### Must-fix
- **M1. The defect leg of the new e2e spec is flaky in CI.** In the `Build & E2E UI` job at this head (check run 134604742004), "the defect this pins: the old jump without a positioned scroller scrolls the dialog box off its title" (`spec.ts:374`) failed on its first attempt and on retry #1, both at line 384 (`dialogScrollTop` received `0`). It passed on retry #2, and Playwright reported it as `1 flaky`. On the same run the overflow assertion on line 383 held, so the hidden inputs did overflow by read time. That leg is the spec's own proof that the fixture reproduces the defect, so a green fix leg means little while it is unreliable. It would also add a known-flaky test to the shared E2E job.
  - My reading of the cause, not measured: `__harness.oldJump` calls `expand(key)` from `page.evaluate`, outside a React event, so React does not flush the unfold before the next frame the way it does after a click. The `requestAnimationFrame` can then fire before the Privacy section's fields (and their hidden inputs) mount. At that moment nothing overflows the dialog, so the old jump has nothing to scroll there.
  - Fix: in the harness, unfold synchronously (`flushSync`) or wait until the section's fields are in the DOM before the old jump. Then report a repeat run of that leg on this spec (for example `--repeat-each=20 --project=chromium`) with zero failures. The same timing applies to the "positioned scroller leaves the old jump nothing to scroll" leg (line 435). Its assertions hold whether or not the jump ran after the mount, so it should take the same harness fix.
  - I'll read the spec delta alone, plus `Build & E2E UI` at the new head with no flaky entry.

#### Should-fix
None.

#### Notes
- **N1.** The report says the e2e matrix ran 6/6 locally in 20.1 s. One local pass does not show the race, which is why I'm asking for the repeat run.
- **N2.** The real nav reveals a collapsed section one frame after `item.expand()` inside the click handler, where React flushes the unfold first. The race above is the harness's, not the product's. The card's untested full-page form (`ObjectForm.tsx`'s sticky nav) now gets the `window.scrollTo` branch, which the unit pin covers.
- **Landing.** The 18.6.0 freeze is lifted (seat comment 6970550718). Owed before landing: M1 and its delta L1. No L2.

### L1 delta review (#35092) · 2026-11-18T07:35Z

L1: ACCEPT
Head-sha: f002ef0c0fd6ac703fc8de4d1e28cc4ff31d6ee6

This is a delta read from my REWORK 6970568129 at `fbeab193b8` to `f002ef0c0f`: one commit, one file (the e2e spec), +31/−7. I also read the final-head comment 6972174183.

**M1, closed.**
- `__harness.oldJump` now unfolds inside `flushSync`, so the Privacy section's fields are committed before the old jump's `requestAnimationFrame` fires. That is the ordering a click on the real navigation gets by unfolding inside a React event.
- The frame records what it found (`jumpSaw.hiddenInputs`), and the new `oldJumpToPrivacy` helper asserts `{ hiddenInputs: 2 }` before the leg reads anything. A jump that runs ahead of the mount now fails with "the old jump ran before the last section unfolded", instead of passing or failing by chance. The fixture's only aria-hidden inputs are the last section's two checkbox stand-ins, so the count is exact.
- Both old-jump legs use it: the defect leg (line 374) and "the positioned scroller leaves the old jump nothing to scroll" (line 435). The fix legs and the source are untouched.
- Evidence: 120/120 on `--repeat-each=20` (the area's reading). CI's `Build & E2E UI` job at this head (134642494697) reports `136 passed` with no flaky entry, where the job at `fbeab193b8` reported `135 passed`, `1 flaky`.

**CI at this head**, read from check-runs (53): 40 success, 13 skipped, none failed, none in progress.

#### Must-fix
None.

#### Should-fix
None.

#### Notes
- N1 and N2 of my first review stand as written.
- **Landing.** Nothing more is owed from L1, and no L2 is owed.
